title: Tiger Rag and the trumpeters who filled in for Carey
summary: Carey's band played Tiger Rag with no special arrangement; Punch, Buddy Petit or blacksmith-trumpeter Peter Lacalle filled in on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
